provenance: Derived from pot_all numerical failures where minimum required increase was printed as a negative delta.

semantic_labels.label: numerical.minimum_delta_nonnegative
semantic_labels.description: Clamp minimum required increase to zero when the target already exceeds the benchmark.

scope.observed_error: minimum increase required was output as a negative number when already sufficient

payload.content: For questions asking the minimum increase required to surpass or reach a target, compute `max(0, target - current)`; if the current value already surpasses the target, the required increase is `0`, not a negative number.
